SUAS-016 — SuperUnicode Egyptian Hieroglyph Database

The runtime counterpart of UAX #57: one 12-byte sign record, a parallel Unikemet metadata table, and a total O(1) answer for every Egyptian codepoint.

SUAS-016 (SUKEMET) is the sixteenth SuperUnicode Architecture Standard and the runtime counterpart of UAX #57, the Unicode Egyptian Hieroglyph Database. UAX #57 publishes Unikemet as a three-field text manifest that an implementation must read, join and interpret at run time. SUKEMET keeps the catalogue and closes the architecture around it: a byte-packed table, a bounded lookup, and a verification surface the compiler must satisfy before it emits a record.

SUKEMET does not re-implement SUAS-006 (STS). STS decides where a grapheme cluster begins and ends; SUKEMET classifies the signs and controls inside the cluster. The two compose; neither re-derives the other.

Why a binary property

Aspect UAX #57 / a text manifest SUKEMET
Catalogue Unikemet.txt parsed and joined per query A 12-byte static record read from a fixed table
Gardiner group Inferred from a catalogue string A byte-indexed SUKEMET_GARDINER_* value
Core class A kEH_Core text field CORE / LEGACY flags plus a one-byte class
Functions A kEH_Func string per row A packed function bitmask
Alternate sequence Re-parsed as text A flattened uint32_t store with offset and length
Format controls Ad-hoc renderer rules Named flags plus a one-byte modifier role
Unlisted codepoint Undefined A total algorithmic default — every Egyptian codepoint answers
Failure mode An implementer’s own reconciliation The verifier names the first of twelve defects

The hieroglyph record

Five fields, 12 bytes, no padding on any supported ABI. They are the seeding sketch’s fields, verbatim: codepoint, phonetic_hash, sukemet_flags, gardiner_category and sub_index.

typedef struct {
uint32_t codepoint; /* 31-bit SUCS codepoint */
uint32_t phonetic_hash; /* FNV-1a of the primary kEH_FVal reading */
uint16_t sukemet_flags; /* Packed classification/control flags */
uint8_t gardiner_category; /* A-Z, AA, or SUKEMET_GARDINER_NONE */
uint8_t sub_index; /* Sequential index within the group */
} sukemet_hieroglyph_entry_t;

The record carries no catalogue index, source mask, Core class, function mask or alternate-sequence length: those live in a parallel metadata table aligned one-to-one with the main table at build time. This preserves the sketch’s exact 12 bytes while carrying the full UAX #57 metadata surface.

The Gardiner taxonomy

Every UAX #57 group A-Z plus AA has a closed constant. Gardiner has no group J, and SUKEMET preserves that gap; AA is the unclassified catch-all. The packed catalogue index is (category << 24) | (subgroup << 16) | item, so A-01-001 is 0x00010001.

Group Domain
A-I, K-Z Man, woman, deities, body parts, mammals, birds, reptiles, fish, invertebrates, plants, sky, buildings, ships, furniture, emblems, dress, warfare, agriculture, rope, vessels, food, writing, strokes
AA Unclassified and extended signs
NONE A format control, blank sign or neography declaration

Core, function and source

The Core class is exactly one of N, C or L; CORE and LEGACY are mutually exclusive flag bits. The function mask records one or more of pictogram, logogram, phonogram, classifier, phono-repeater, radicogram, interpretant and control. The source mask records which Unikemet fields were present, so an absent kEH_FVal is distinguishable from a hash that happens to be zero.

Unikemet field SUKEMET representation
kEH_Cat Gardiner category, sub-index and packed catalogue index
kEH_Core CORE / LEGACY flags and core_class
kEH_Desc description_hash
kEH_Func function_types bitmask
kEH_FVal phonetic_hash of the primary alternative
kEH_AltSeq alternate_length and suas_sukemet_alt_seq_at
kEH_NoMirror / kEH_NoRotate NO_MIRROR / NO_ROTATE flags

Format controls and enclosures

The Egyptian Hieroglyph Format Controls block is curated from Unicode 18.0.0: vertical and horizontal joiners, insert-at positions, the overlay middle, begin and end segment, the rounded cartouche, the rectangular serekh, the mirror control, the blank and lost signs, and the damage modifiers. A cartouche is SUKEMET_ENCLOSURE_CARTOUCHE; a serekh-style frame is SUKEMET_ENCLOSURE_SEREKH; a neography may declare SUKEMET_ENCLOSURE_CUSTOM.

Unicode 18.0.0 defines no standard Egyptian shading control. SUKEMET still names SUKEMET_MODIFIER_SHADING, but a shading modifier is always an RNUR declaration and is never a mislabelled standard codepoint.

Totality and neography

A codepoint inside the Egyptian blocks or the Native & Neography Plane carve-out (0x00160000–0x0016FFFF) always resolves. If no curated row exists, SUKEMET synthesizes the record of section 6 — zero hash, no Gardiner group, and the NEOGRAPHY flag in RNUR — while suas_sukemet_is_registered remains false. A renderer can therefore answer for an unassigned Extended-A slot or a newly declared RNUR coordinate without special-casing a missing lookup.

The shipped table carries 5,109 curated records: 5,067 Unikemet signs, 38 format-control, blank/lost and damage codepoints, and four RNUR declarations. It also carries 98 alternate sequences covering 265 codepoints.

Verification names the defect

suas_sukemet_validate_table returns the first of twelve named outcomes: a NULL table, a count over capacity, an unordered pair, a duplicate codepoint, a codepoint past the space, an inadmissible codepoint, a reserved or contradictory flag bit, an invalid Gardiner category, a flag/category disagreement, a format control outside its block, a neography flag outside RNUR, or Core and Legacy set together. An empty registry is valid: an implementation with no curated records ships zero rows and conforms.

Classification note

SUKEMET is a SUAS core invariant, registered as SUAS-016, the number immediately after SUAS-015 (SUAMR). One element of the SUTS framing survives deliberately: the registry contents are version data, so an implementation with no curated records ships an empty table and remains conformant — while the engine, the record layout, the taxonomy and the verification rules are mandatory architecture.

Reference implementation: include/suas/suas_sukemet.h + src/suas/suas_sukemet.c (freestanding C99, no heap), registered in suas_static and in the SSRE registry as a MANDATORY specification.

Source of truth: docs/suas/SUAS-016-sukemet.md in the repository.
